about: Frontend intel contract coverage with synthetic data. No native acceptance receipts. The orchestrator vendors kit updates; unavailable kinds use the host's visible error fallback.

features.title: Open local intelligence through the stock plugin command
features.expect: Help lists intel; stock command.dispatch output is validated before publishing one host-owned inline card without optional gateway methods

features.title: Switch intel tabs and refresh in place
features.entry: intel tab intent and kit or host Refresh
features.expect: Tabs update the same publication without RPC; refresh re-calls the stock command and preserves the selected tab

features.title: Read climb detail in a text panel
features.expect: A snapshot-owned run id reaches the read-only climb subcommand; validated backend text opens in a panel

features.title: Read a skill description in a text panel
features.expect: A snapshot-owned skill name reaches the read-only skill subcommand; validated backend text opens in a panel

features.title: Read a failure ledger entry in a text panel
features.expect: A snapshot-owned signature reaches the read-only failure subcommand; validated backend text opens in a panel

features.title: Reject invalid intel data and stale actions
features.entry: intel stock replies and host-owned actions
features.expect: Unknown actions and invalid data show notes; foreign entities cannot dispatch; session, profile, transcript and revision changes discard stale work

features.title: Show a visible fallback for unavailable pinned kit kinds
features.expect: The pinned intel kind renders when available; otherwise the wrapper shows source notes and the missing-kind error without a replacement renderer or demo workaround
